name: Distance sampler
plain: Each step tries several Euler moves (three by default, falling to one near the end), asks the model at the next sigma for each, and blends the slopes with weights that favour the ones closest to the rest. It spends extra model calls to steady the step.
math:
Symbols: d_i slopes from R resamples.
w_i ∝ (1 − (Σ_j |d_i − d_j| − min)/(max − min))^p, normalised; d = Σ w_i·d_i.
x' = x + d·(σ↓ − σ).
